heardle.title: Heardle: Guess the Song Daily Challenge
heardle.slogan: Test Your Music Knowledge with Heardle
heardle.description: Heardle is a daily music guessing game that challenges you to identify popular songs in just six tries. Inspired by Wordle, Heardle offers a unique twist by focusing on music. With minimal cues, you’ll need to rely on your musical spontaneity and genre knowledge to build an impressive winning streak. Ready to test your skills? Play Heardle now!

HomeIframe.title: Heardle: Guess the Song Daily Challenge
HomeIframe.description: Challenge yourself with Heardle, a daily music guessing game. Identify popular songs in six tries and showcase your musical knowledge. Play now!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Heardle: Guess the Song Daily Challenge
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Heardle is a daily music guessing game where players have six chances to identify the song of the day. It’s a musical twist on the popular Wordle game.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Listen to the song snippet provided.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Guess the song title or artist.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: You have six tries to guess correctly.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: A new song to guess every day.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Identify songs with just a short snippet.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Build your streak by guessing correctly.
